# UNIQUE\_LOCK\_TTL variable

Time-to-live (seconds) of processed-message markers created by execution locks; expired markers are cleaned up on subsequent unique lock acquisitions

**Signature:**

```typescript
UNIQUE_LOCK_TTL = 3600
```
